The settings overhaul — the old wall-of-tiles overlay has been completely redesigned into a clean side navigation panel, and broken controls across integrations and configuration have been fixed.

## Highlights

- **Side navigation for settings.** Settings is now organized into dedicated, focused pages (General, Tablets, OBS, Spotify, Discord, Voicemeeter, AI Usage, About). Pages mount on demand so idle background probes (e.g. Discord and Voicemeeter) no longer run unconditionally whenever settings is opened.
- **Keyboard shortcut capture.** The touch-mode shortcut can now be set naturally by pressing the desired key combination instead of typing key names into an input field.
- **Always-ready USB / ADB tablet installation.** The USB/APK install section is always visible and automatically queries connected ADB devices on open.
- **Quick folder access.** Added buttons in the About page to open the application data directory and logs directly in the file manager.
- **Seamless credential saving.** Discord Connect and Spotify Log in automatically save unsaved fields first before attempting to authenticate.

## Fixes

- **Settings persistence.** `get_settings` now reads from `editor.json` instead of stale launch-time state, fixing an issue where changes to the port or start-minimized setting appeared reverted when reopening the overlay.
- **Immediate OBS toggle.** Toggling the OBS integration now applies immediately without requiring a separate save.
- **Localized Discord status.** Discord connection status is now translated through the client locale instead of returning a hardcoded Polish string from the backend.
- **Cleaner UI.** Removed unused and non-functional controls including static `0.0.0.0` facts, the unchangeable close-to-tray row, and duplicate port displays.
- **Revoke confirmation.** Tablet device revocation now uses the shared confirmation dialog.

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.7.0.exe` below — the updater feed is pointing here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.7.0.apk` over the previous version.
